question:
A customer asks an engineer to develop a framework that will be used to replace the process of the manual device configuration of Cisco NX-OS devices. The engineer plans to use the programmatic interface that meets these requirements:
- The development team is familiar with Windows-based scripting environment using PowerShell.
- The customer's security requirements mandate the use of HTTPS transport.
Which solution must be used to meet these requirements?
theory: NX-OS doesn't expose a PowerShell-specific protocol, but because NX-API puts the CLI behind ordinary HTTP/HTTPS, any language — including PowerShell via its web-request cmdlets — can drive the switch programmatically once 'feature nxapi' is enabled, satisfying both the PowerShell tooling and HTTPS transport requirements. NETCONF-YANG uses SSH rather than HTTPS, VISORE is an APIC-specific MO browser (not applicable to standalone NX-OS), and the Open Agent Container hosts agent-based tools rather than exposing an API. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 16 — Automation and Scripting Tools)
